key.text: I want to make a phone stand for my desk out of wood. It should hold my phone at a slight angle, fit in my hand, and I only need one.

output.summary: You are making a small wooden phone stand for your desk.

needs.why: You need to cut and shape wood for the stand.
A laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely) can cut out wooden parts cleanly.

routes.process: Cut wooden pieces using a laser cutter and glue them together.
routes.fit_reason: The Baum Family Maker Space has all the wood and cutting tools you need. This is a very simple project for your first build.

steps.title: Draw your design
steps.detail: Sketch the pieces for your phone stand on a computer.

steps.title: Cut the wood
steps.detail: Use the laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely) to cut your wooden parts.

steps.title: Assemble the stand
steps.detail: Glue the cut pieces together to form your phone stand.

warnings.issue: You need safety training before using the equipment.
warnings.fix: Complete the Level 1 orientation at the maker space first.
